title: Astronomer alleges targeted attacks over UFO research
excerpt: Astronomer Beatriz Villarroel claims she has faced targeted harassment and professional sabotage from within the scientific community following her research into the missing stars phenomenon and unide...
content:
LAS VEGAS (KLAS) - Astronomer Beatriz Villarroel always assumed there would be some resistance to her ideas when she began researching the missing stars phenomenon. She just didn't know the lengths people would go.

In the full unedited interview with George Knapp in this article, she detailed how she feels she is being targeted:

"In 2021, they already started targeting me when we came up with the first paper, when we saw, 'hey', this looks like UFOs. They didn't attack me at that time for working with the UFOs. At that moment, it was people who blocked me out of conferences for my collaboration with Jeff Marcy. Today, of course, when I look back at that, I look at who is there, people who did this, and who are they connected to. And then I know that. Well, I will not finish that sentence, but I will say they are connections that make me think of certain programs like legacy. Yeah. So that's all I will say about that. But I keep a record of these things because I just need to know for myself if I'm getting, like, paranoid or so. After we came out with the papers last year, I expressed disappointment to part of the UAP scientist community because there have been very targeted attacks that have not been nice. There has been foul play in the background. Including contacting common colleagues and trying to make my life as hard as possible. And I don't think this has been a very beautiful act, and I hope that people can act with more dignity in the future. And if you disagree, you can write a scientific paper disagreeing on the science. You don't need to try to destroy another person, and they try the latter."

She is not alone, however, as others in the astronomy field - as well as UFO researchers - support her while the battle over the evidence she has presented intensifies.
